system.description: Take on the semblance of a decaying corpse yourself by spending a Blood Trait, or inflict it on another by spending the Blood Trait and defeating him in a challenge of your Mental Traits against his Physical Traits. The subject gains the Negative Traits Decrepit, Lethargic, and Repugnant, but gains a free retest to remain motionless and is up three Traits when intimidating or inflicting fear. A vampire can reverse the effect early by spending two Blood Traits.
